op.title: Persecution of PUNKS and HIP-HOPPERS
op.body: another DIY venue got shot up by the Unamerican Activities FARCE in Philly. In the 'land of the free' it's now a crime to listen to music that our fascist government doesn't like. You put gel in your hair the wrong way and they send jackboots to beat you. We're just supposed to listen to radio-friendly oldies-revival crap til we die? Fuck that.

replies.body: Lighten up. A few arrests and you act like it's the a goddamn genocide. If the UAF wanted to shoot a place up, you'd be counting the bodies until next week. That hoodlum shit needs to be kept in line more than we need so-called free speech. Sorry, just keeping it real.
I'm happy listening to the Ink Spots because I love my people and I love my country. I don't need subversive noise and disgusting leather sex-wear to feel content.
Punks are the exact sort of people who would kill and eat you the moment you step out of your bomb shelter.

yeah that's right, I'm just fiending for some musty unwashed bomb shelter ass. Get real. I'm an American just like you are, I'm not your enemy just because I listen to loud music and wear spiked belts
It's a slippery slope. If it's a crime to express yourself in certain ways, where does it stop?
I don't care where it stops as long as it includes hippies.
what the fuck is a chinese
